Priya: Need quick eyes: PR #8123 (kv-cache race fix) needs 2x LGTM before 14:00 PT cutoff. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8123 — this is blocking the hotfix rollout for prod-1. Tests pass locally but CI is flaky on linux unit-3.
Alex: On it, just assigned myself. Pinged in the PR. Will look at the failing test now.
Maya: I can do a pass in ~20m. Any repro steps or logs?
Priya: Repro I used: `pytest tests/unit/test_kv.py::test_race --maxfail=1 -q` — repro on my machine, gist with logs: https://gist.github.com/priya/abcd1234. The failing assert is in async flush timing.
Sam: Heads up — saw a similar flake last week, might be the async flush scheduling. If we don't have 2x LGTM by 13:30 PT we'll need to follow the rollback plan (revert commit `98f4a1`). @ReleaseBot can you pre-schedule a canary hold? :eyes: 
ReleaseBot: CI status: 4/6 checks passing (2 flaky-units). Canary hold tentatively scheduled at 13:45 PT unless a `merge` event occurs.
Alex: Left a small comment in the PR about a missing nil-check on the callback path, added a suggested change.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll apply Alex's suggestion and run the unit test loop locally, will report back.
Priya: Thanks — if both reviews LGTM I'll merge and monitor. If not, I'll trigger rollback procedure at cutoff.
Maya: LGTM after applying Alex's suggestion and re-running tests (ran 50 loops locally, no failure). Added a small test tweak to make timing more deterministic.
Alex: LGTM after nit fixed. Merging now with `/merge` (will watch canary).
ReleaseBot: Merge detected by Alex at 13:10 PT. Canary rollout started: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1234. Monitoring health: initial token latency stable, logs streaming.
Priya: Closing loop — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
Sam: Great job team, will keep an eye on metrics for the next hour.
